about: Solomon and the Queen swear a mutual oath: he will not overpower her, and she will not take anything from his house by force. They lie in one room, and he sets a trap: a jar of water, a servant told in another tongue to sleep, and a ceiling of lights. Thirsty, she rises to drink and he catches her hand, saying she has broken the oath; she answers that she has wronged herself and frees him from his oath, and he lets her drink, and they sleep together. Solomon then dreams of a sun that leaves Israel for Ethiopia, and of a second sun that Israel tries to put out, which rises again and lights the world. He wakes shaken, the Queen asks to go home, and he sends her off with great wealth and wonderful carts.

sentences.l: He-answered-her and-he-said-to-her: I-will-swear to-you that not he-overpower-you, but you-too swear that not you-take-by-force everything which-in house-my;
sentences.i: He answered her and said: "I will swear to you that I will not overpower you; but you also must swear that you will not take by force anything that is in my house."
sentences.n: አውሥኣ 'he answered her' (አውሥአ + -ኣ 'her'); ወይቤላ 'and he said to her' (ይቤ + -ላ). The speaker is Solomon, replying to her demand at the end of ch. 29. እምሕል is the 1st singular imperfect (subjunctive) of መሐለ 'swear', with the እ- prefix; ለኪ 'to you' (feminine). ከመ ኢይትኀየልኪ: ከመ 'that' + negative + ተኀየለ 'prevail over, use force against' + -ኪ 'you'. The verb is 3rd masculine (ይ-), where I would expect 1st person (እ-) for Solomon speaking of himself; I read it as 'I' (?), the oath being phrased impersonally. ወባሕቱ 'but'; አንቲኒ 'you also' (አንቲ + -ኒ); መሐሊ is the feminine imperative of መሐለ; ኢትትኀየሊ 'that you not take by force' (2nd feminine). ኵሎ ዘውስተ ቤትየ: ኵሎ 'all' + ዘ- 'that which' + ውስተ 'in' + ቤትየ 'my house'.

sentences.i: She said to him: "Swear to me that you will not overpower me, and I in turn will swear that I will not take your goods by force."
sentences.n: መሐል 'swear!' (masculine imperative); ኢትትኀየለኒ 'that you not overpower me' (as in the previous part). ወአነሂ እምሕል 'and I too will swear'. ከመ ኢይትኀየል ንዋየከ: the verb is again 3rd masculine ('that he not take by force') where 'I' is meant (?); ንዋየከ 'your goods' (accusative). sentences.i: The king went up onto his bed on one side (of the room?), and for her too they prepared a bed on one side.
sentences.n: ወዐርገ 'and he went up' (ዐርገ 'ascend, mount'). ምስካብ 'bed, couch' (from ሰከበ 'lie down'). በ፩ ገጽ: the numeral ፩ is 'one', spoken አሐዱ (ʾaḥadu), agreeing with masculine ገጽ 'face, side, place': 'on one side', or 'in one place' (?). It is not clear whether the two beds stand at the same side of the room (so close together) or each at a side of its own; I keep the literal 'on one side' for both. ወላቲኒ 'and for her too' (ለ- + ቲ + -ኒ). አስተዳለዉ 'they prepared' (አስተዳለወ, 3rd masculine plural).

sentences.l: And-he-said-to-him, to-the-boy servant: Wash jars-(?) and-put bowl of-water while she-sees queen, and-shut doors and-sleep;
sentences.i: He said to a young servant: "Wash the jars (?) and set a bowl of water out while the Queen watches; then shut the doors and go to sleep."
sentences.n: ሕፃን ገብር 'young servant' (ሕፃን 'child, boy'; ገብር 'servant'), with ለ- as the marker of the person addressed. All the verbs are imperatives: ኅፅብ (ኀፀበ 'wash'), ደይ (ወደየ 'put, set'), ዕጸው (ዐጸወ 'close'), ኑም (ኖመ 'sleep'). መቃልድ is the plural of መቅለድ, which I take as a water-jar or similar vessel (?), because the next unit has the Queen lifting 'the water of the መቅለድ' to drink; ኅፅብ is plainly the imperative of ኀፀበ 'wash'; what is washed, መቃልድ, is the uncertain part, so 'wash the jars' is a guess. ጻሕብ 'bowl' (?), probably a vessel for water. እንዘ ትሬኢ ንግሥት 'while the Queen sees' (ትሬኢ 3rd feminine of ርእየ). ኀዋኅው 'doors' (plural of ኆኅት).

sentences.n: ዘንተ 'this' (accusative, object of ይቤሎ). ዘይቤሎ 'which he said to him' (ዘ- + ይቤ + -ሎ). ካልእ ልሳን 'another language' (ካልእ 'other, second'; ልሳን 'tongue, language'). ዘኢታአምር ንግሥት 'which the Queen does not know' (አእመረ 'know', 3rd feminine imperfect). So the servant is told, in a language she cannot follow, to wash, set out the water and sleep, so that the Queen does not know what has been arranged (my inference).

sentences.i: But the king was not yet asleep; he made himself seem to be sleeping, and he kept watch (?).
sentences.n: ወንጉሥሰ 'and the king, for his part' (-ሰ contrastive); ዓዲሁ 'still, yet' (ዓዲ + -ሁ); ኢኖመ 'did not sleep'. ይሬሲ ርእሶ ከመ ንዉም 'he makes himself like a sleeper' (ረሰየ 'make'; ርእሶ 'himself', literally 'his head'; ንዉም 'sleeping'). ያስተሓይጽ is the causative-reflexive of an unclear root; I take it as 'watch closely, peer' (?), because in unit 17 the Queen does the same thing before she looks toward him.

sentences.l: And-house-his-indeed, of-Solomon king, even-by-night bright like day, because he-made by-wisdom pearls(?) shining, likenesses of-sun and-moon and-stars, in vault-of his-house;
sentences.i: Now the house of King Solomon was bright even at night, like day, because by his wisdom he had made shining pearls (?), likenesses of sun, moon and stars, in the vault of his house.
sentences.n: ወቤቱሰ ለሰሎሞን ንጉሥ 'and his house, that of King Solomon' (the possessor is given with ለ-, after the suffixed noun). ሌሊተኒ 'even by night' (ሌሊት + -ኒ); ብርህት 'bright' (feminine, agreeing with ቤት). እስመ ገብረ በጥበብ 'because he made by wisdom'. ባሕርያት (plural of ባሕርይ) means 'natures' or 'pearls'; I take 'pearls' (?), the sense Dillmann gives for it, since the things made are bright and are likenesses of the heavenly bodies. አምሳለ 'likenesses of' (construct of አምሳል). ጠፈረ ቤቱ 'vault of his house' (ጠፈር 'firmament, vault'). A sun-moon-stars ceiling: the house gives light by night, which is what lets him watch her. Unit ends at ፨.

sentences.i: The Queen also slept a little, and when she woke her mouth was dry with thirst, since by his wisdom what he had given her was thirst-making (?). She was exceedingly thirsty; her mouth was dry and parched (?), and she found no moisture.
sentences.n: ወንግሥትኒ 'and the Queen too'; ኖመት 'she slept'; ንስቲተ 'a little'. ሶበ ነቅሀት 'when she awoke' (ነቅሀ). የብሰ አፉሃ 'her mouth was dry' (የብሰ 'be dry'; አፍ 'mouth' + -ሃ 'her'). መጻምእ I take as a noun 'thing that causes thirst' (መ- + ጸምአ 'be thirsty'), so 'because by his wisdom what he gave her was thirst-making' (?); this refers back to the spiced food sent to her in ch. 29, a deliberate stratagem, and the parse of ዘወሀባ መጻምአ is a guess. ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. አርመስመሰት is a four-radical verb I cannot place with certainty; 'her mouth grew rough, parched' is a guess from the context (?). ኢረከበት ጠለ 'she found no dew', that is, no moisture (ጠል 'dew').

sentences.l: And-she-thought of-drinking water which she-saw, and-she-peered and-she-looked toward king Solomon, and-it-seemed-to-her that-he-slept sound sleep;
sentences.i: She thought of drinking the water she had seen; she peered and looked toward King Solomon, and it seemed to her that he was sound asleep.
sentences.n: ኀለየት 'she thought, considered' (ኀለየ), with ሰቲየ ማይ 'drinking of water' (the infinitive of ሰትየ). ዘርእየት 'which she had seen' (ርእየ, 3rd feminine). አስተሓየጸት ወነጸረት 'she peered and looked' (ነጸረ 'look'; the first verb as in unit 14, (?)). መሰላ 'it seemed to her' (መሰለ + -ላ). ዘኖመ ጽኑዐ ንዋመ 'that he slept a deep sleep' (ጽኑዕ 'firm, deep'; ንዋም 'sleep', a cognate accusative).

sentences.i: But he was not asleep; he was waiting for her to get up and steal water for her thirst.
sentences.n: ወውእቱሰ 'but he'; ኢኖመ 'did not sleep'; አላ 'but'. ይጸንሕ 'he waits' (ጸንሐ 'wait, be on the watch'); እስከ ትትነሣእ 'until she rises' (ተንሥአ). ከመ ትስርቅ ማየ 'that she steal water'. ለጽምአ 'for thirst' (ለ- + ጽምእ in the accusative form ጽምአ, with the first-order አ; the suffix 'her' would be -ኣ or -ሃ, so it is not 'her thirst' in the Geʿez, though the Queen's thirst is meant). sentences.l: And-he-seized her-hand before she-drink water, and-he-said-to-her: Why have-you-transgressed oath which you-swore that not you-take-by-force everything which-in house-my?

sentences.n: ወእስራኤልሰ 'but Israel' (-ሰ contrastive). አስተአከይዎ ለፀሐይ 'they despised the sun' (አስተአከየ 'despise', 3rd plural + -ዎ 'him', then the noun with ለ-). እምላህቡ 'from his blaze' (ላህብ 'flame, blaze'), read as the reason (?). ወኢሖሩ በብርሃኑ 'and did not walk by his light' (ሖረ 'go, walk'). ተሀየዮሙ ለእስራኤል: a ተ-stem 3rd masculine singular perfect with the suffix -ዮሙ 'them', and ለእስራኤል in apposition; I cannot identify the root (the word recurs in unit 35). 'Turned away from' is a guess from the context; 'was angry with' would suit as well (?). ቀንኡ ላዕሌሁ 'they were jealous against him' (ቀንአ 'be zealous, jealous'). ተስእነ ሰላም 'peace became impossible' (ሰአነ 'be unable' (?)); ማእከሌሆሙ ወማእከለ ፀሐይ 'between them and between the sun'.

sentences.i: They raised their hands against it, with clubs (?) and knives, and wanted to put out the sun. They darkened the whole world with quaking and gloom, and it seemed to them that it would never rise for them again.
sentences.n: አንሥኡ እደዊሆሙ ላዕሌሁ 'they raised their hands against him' (አንሥአ; እደዊሆሙ 'their hands'). ምስለ 'with'. አብትር I read as 'clubs, cudgels' (?) and መጣብሕ as 'knives' (plural of መጥባሕት 'knife', from ጠብሐ 'slaughter'); the first is uncertain. ያጥፍእዎ ለፀሐይ 'that they extinguish the sun' (አጥፍአ 'put out, destroy'). አጽለምዋ ለኵሉ ዓለም 'they darkened the whole world' (አጽለመ); the subject is literally 'they', the Israelites. ድልቅልቅ 'quaking, shaking'; ጊሜ 'gloom, darkness'. መሰሎሙ ዘኢይሠርቅ 'it seemed to them that it would not rise' (as መሰላ in unit 17).

sentences.i: They destroyed his light, buried him (?), and guarded what was laid up of him (?) in the place where they put him.
sentences.n: አማሰኑ 'they destroyed' (አማሰነ 'ruin, destroy'). ደበይዎ is a verb I cannot place; 'buried him' is from the sequence of the sentence (?); another sense of ill-treatment or sealing in would suit as well. ዐቀቡ 'they guarded' (ዐቀበ). ዝኅሮ 'his store, what is laid up' (ዝኅር 'treasure, store', + 'his'), here perhaps 'his tomb, his remains' (?). ኀበ ወደይዎ 'where they put him' (ወደየ). sentences.n: ወፅአ 'he came out'. እምኀበ ኢተሐዘብዎ 'from where they had not reckoned him' (ተሐዘበ 'reckon, expect'). ወፈድፋድሰ 'and above all' (ፈድፋድ + -ሰ). ቀዳሚ ባሕር ወ ፡ በደኃሪ ባሕር: 'first sea' and 'last sea' (ቀዳሚ 'first', ደኃሪ 'last'); the printed text separates the ወ 'and' from the next word by a wordspace. The seas are probably the eastern and western limits of the world, but the text does not say. ለኢትዮጵያ ወለሮም 'for Ethiopia and for Rome'.

sentences.n: ነግሠት 'she reigned' (ነግሠ). ፮ is the numeral 6, spoken ስድስቱ (sədstu) as in ch. 23; before ዓመተ 'years' (accusative of ዓመት) the numeral may take its own accusative form (ስድስተ), so the exact spoken form is uncertain (?). በብሔራ 'in her land'. ወእንዘ ከመዝ ተድላሃ ወክብራ 'and while such [was] her delight and her glory' (ተድላ 'delight, pleasure'; ከመዝ 'thus'). አንጽሐት ሥጋሃ 'she purified / kept pure her body' (አንጽሐ 'make pure', causative of the root of ንጽሕት 'pure'; ሥጋ 'flesh, body'). sentences.l: And-he-entered to dwelling-his and-he-gave-her all what is-needed: honor and-wealth, and-beautiful garments which plunder eyes, and-all what is-needed, honor for-land-of Ethiopia, and-mounts-(?) and-carts about 6 thousand-(?) laden with goods-of honor which is-needed, and-carts which carry on sand-(?), and-cart which goes on sea, and-cart which runs on winds, which he-made according-to wisdom which gave-him God.
sentences.i: He went into his dwelling and gave her everything needed: honor and wealth, fine garments that dazzle the eyes, and all that was needed to honor the land of Ethiopia; and mounts (?) and carts, about six thousand (?) of them, laden with the honorable goods that were needed; and carts that carry their loads over sand (?), and a cart that goes on the sea, and a cart that runs upon the winds, which he made according to the wisdom God had given him.
sentences.n: ቦአ ኀበ ማኅደሩ 'he went into his dwelling' (ማኅደር 'dwelling, lodging'). ወወሀባ ኵሎ ዘይትፈቀድ 'and he gave her all that is needed' (ተፈቀደ 'be wished, needed'). ሠናያነ አልባሰ 'beautiful garments' (accusative plural); ዘየሀይድ አዕይንተ 'which plunder the eyes' (ሀየደ, as in unit 3), i.e. dazzle (?). ክብረ ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'honor for the land of Ethiopia'. ራኩባት I take as 'mounts, riding beasts' (the Arabic sense; camels?) (?). ሰረገላ 'cart, chariot, wagon'. መጠነ 'about, as much as'. ፮ ሲሕ: ፮ is 6, spoken ስድስቱ (sədstu); ሲሕ I read as 'thousand' (the Amharic and Tigrinya word is ሺህ), so 'six thousand' (?). ዘጽዑን 'laden' (ጸዐነ 'load'; ጽዑን, plural). ንዋየ ክብር 'goods of honor'. እለ ይጼዐኑ ዲበ ኆጻ: ኆጻ 'sand' (so glossed in an earlier part), here the ground of sand (?); ይጼዐኑ is the active 3rd plural imperfect of ጸዐነ 'carry, load', so 'which carry' (their loads or riders, the object being unstated) (?). The three carts, on land, sea and wind, are Solomon's own making by the wisdom God gave him (ዘወሀቦ 'which he gave him'); that is as far as the text goes, and no mechanism is given. The unit has about 44 words, kept whole because it has no ፤ to cut at; it ends at ፨.

glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
glossary.እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun)
glossary.እሰርቅኑ: ሰረቀ — shall I steal? (1cs subjunctive/imperfect, G, s-r-q + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.እስተይ: ሰትየ — that I drink (1cs subjunctive, G)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ኮንኩኑ: ኮነ — have I become? (1cs perfect, G + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.ወ: ወ — and (conjunction, written as a separate word before ይቤሉ) · also a separate word before በደኃሪ ባሕር ('and in the last sea')
glossary.ወለሮም: ሮም — and for Rome (ወ- + ለ- + proper name)
glossary.ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
glossary.ወለእስራኤልሰ: እስራኤል — and for Israel indeed (ወ- + ለ- + proper name + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወላቲኒ: ለ — and for her too (ወ- + ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወሖረት: ሖረ — and she went (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወመሐለ: መሐለ — and he swore (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወመሰላ: መሰለ — and it seemed to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs to her')
glossary.ወመሰሎሙ: መሰለ — and it seemed to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ሎሙ '3mp to them')
glossary.ወመንግሥትየኒ: መንግሥት — and my kingdom too (ወ- + noun + -የ '1cs my' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወመጣብሕ: መጥባሕት — and knives (ወ- + plural መጣብሕ of መጥባሕት 'knife')
glossary.ወማሕላሰ: ማሕላ — and as for the oath (ወ- + noun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወማእከለ: ማእከል — and between (ወ- + noun, accusative/construct 'middle of')
glossary.ወሠናያነ: ሠናይ — and fine, beautiful (ወ- + adjective, plural accusative)
glossary.ወራኩባተ: ራኩብ — and riding beasts, mounts (?) (ወ- + plural ራኩባት, apparently the Arabic rākiba, 'riding beast'; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወሰሐቀት: ሰሐቀ — and she laughed (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, s-ḥ-q)
glossary.ወሰረረት: ሰረረ — and she sped, flew (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect; root and sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — and a cart, chariot (ወ- + noun)
glossary.ወሰረገላተ: ሰረገላ — and carts, chariots (ወ- + plural ሰረገላት, accusative)
glossary.ወቤቱሰ: ቤት — and his house indeed (ወ- + noun + -ሁ 'his' + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወብዕለ: ብዕል — and riches, wealth (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተመሥጠት: ተመሥጠ — and she/it was snatched away (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወተስእነ: ተስእነ — and it became impossible (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ሰአነ 'be unable')
glossary.ወተንሥአት: ተንሥአ — and she arose (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወትበ: ይቤ — and she said (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ, here spelled ትበ)
glossary.ወትበሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of ይቤ, here spelled ትበ, + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወኀለየት: ኀለየ — and she thought, considered (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወኀደጋ: ኀደገ — and he let her, left her (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወኅድገኒ: ኀደገ — and leave me, let me (ወ- + imperative 2ms, G + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.ወነቅሀ: ነቅሀ — and he woke (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወነግሠት: ነግሠ — and she reigned (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, n-g-ś)
glossary.ወነጸረት: ነጸረ — and she looked (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወኑም: ኖመ — and sleep! (ወ- + imperative 2ms, G, n-w-m)
glossary.ወንጉሥሰ: ንጉሥ — and the king indeed (ወ- + noun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወንግሥትኒ: ንግሥት — and the queen too (ወ- + noun, fem. + emphatic -ኒ)
glossary.ወንጽሕት: ንጹሕ — and pure (ወ- + adjective, fem. sg.)
glossary.ወኖመ: ኖመ — and he slept (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወኖሙ: ኖመ — and they slept (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአማሰኑ: አማሰነ — and they destroyed (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ማሰነ 'perish')
glossary.ወአምሐላ: አምሐለ — and he made her swear (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወአርመስመሰት: አርመስመሰ — and (it) grew rough, parched (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect, quadriliteral; root and sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወአስተሓየጸት: አስተሓየጸ — and she peered (ወ- + 3fs perfect; root and sense uncertain, 'peer, look intently') (?)
glossary.ወአብርሀ: አብርሀ — and he/it shone (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative)
glossary.ወአብርሀት: አብርሀ — and she shone (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative of በርሀ 'be bright'; ፀሐይ treated as fem.)
glossary.ወአኀዛ: አኀዘ — and he seized her (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወአነሂ: አነ — and I too (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + enclitic -ሂ 'also, indeed')
glossary.ወአንሥአት: አንሥአ — and she lifted (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative of the root ነሥአ)
glossary.ወአንሥኡ: አንሥአ — and they raised (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative)
glossary.ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአውሥአት: አውሥአ — and she answered (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative, w-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወአጽለምዋ: አጽለመ — and they darkened it (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ጸልመ 'be dark' + -ዋ '3fs it')
glossary.ወኢሖሩ: ሖረ — and they did not walk, go (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወኢረከበት: ረከበ — and she did not find (ወ- + ኢ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወኢገብአት: ገብአ — and she did not return (ወ- + ኢ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወእሙንቱሂ: እሙንቱ — and they too (ወ- + 3mp pronoun + enclitic -ሂ 'also, indeed')
glossary.ወእስራኤልሰ: እስራኤል — and Israel indeed (ወ- + proper name + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወወሀባ: ወሀበ — and he gave her (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወወረደ: ወረደ — and he/it descended (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, w-r-d)
glossary.ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዐርገ: ዐርገ — and he ascended (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ወዐቀቡ: ዐቀበ — and they guarded (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወዕጸው: ዐጸወ — and shut! (ወ- + imperative 2ms, G, ʿ-ṣ-w)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወየብሰ: የብስ — and dry land (ወ- + noun, accusative of place 'by land') · accusative object 'and dry land' (ወባሕረ ወየብሰ 'sea and dry land', as things made)
glossary.ወያስተሓይጽ: አስተሓየጸ — and he watches (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative-tä-stem; root and sense uncertain, 'peer, watch') (?)
glossary.ወይሬሲ: ረሰየ — and he makes, makes himself (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, r-s-y)
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወደበይዎ: ደበየ — and they buried him (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዎ 'him'; lemma reconstructed from the form, root and sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወደይ: ወደየ — and put! (imperative 2ms, G, w-d-y 'place, put')
glossary.ወደይዎ: ወደየ — and they put him (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወጊሜ: ጊሜ — and gloom, mist, darkness (ወ- + noun)
glossary.ወጐንደይኩ: ጐንደየ — and I waited, lingered (ወ- + 1cs perfect; 'linger, wait') (?)
glossary.ወፈቀዱ: ፈቀደ — and they wished (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወፈድፋድሰ: ፈድፋድ — and especially, above all (ወ- + adverb + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
glossary.ዘመሐለ: መሐለ — what he swore (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, m-ḥ-l)
glossary.ዘመሐልኪ: መሐለ — which you swore (ዘ- relative + 2fs perfect, G)
glossary.ዘመጻእኩ: መጽአ — that I came (ዘ- 'that' + 1cs perfect, G, m-ḍ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘርኢኪ: ርእየ — which you saw (ዘ- relative + 2fs perfect, G)
glossary.ዘርእየት: ርእየ — what she saw (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ዘትካት: ትካት — of establishment, the established (?) (ዘ- + noun; cf. ተከለ 'plant, establish') (?)
glossary.ዘአምሐልክኒ: አምሐለ — which you made me swear (ዘ- relative + 2fs/2ms perfect, causative + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.ዘኢታአምር: አእመረ — which she does not know (ዘ- relative + ኢ- + 3fs imperfect, causative-stem 'know')
glossary.ዘኢወሀበኒ: ወሀበ — which he did not give me (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negative + 3ms perfect + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘኢይሠርቅ: ሠረቀ — that it not rise (ዘ- 'that' + ኢ- + 3ms jussive/imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her')
glossary.ዘወሀባ: ወሀበ — which he gave her (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኣ 3fs object suffix)
glossary.ዘወሀቦ: ወሀበ — which he gave him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
glossary.ዘውስተ: ውስተ — which is in (ዘ- relative + preposition ውስተ)
glossary.ዘየሀይድ: ሀየደ — which dazzles (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G; root and sense uncertain) · here 'which plunders/captivates the eyes' (ሀየደ 'plunder, carry off'; cf. አሀይድ in this part) (?)
glossary.ዘየሐውር: ሖረ — which goes, travels (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘይረውጽ: ሮጸ — which runs (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, r-w-ṣ)
glossary.ዘይቤሎ: ብህለ — what he said to him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect ይቤ + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ዘይትኀጥአኒ: ተኀጥአ — what is lacking to me, what fails me (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem + -ኒ 'me'; root ኀጥአ 'err, miss') (?)
glossary.ዘይትፈቀድ: ተፈቀደ — what is needed, required (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect passive of ፈቀደ)
glossary.ዘይኄይስ: ኀየሰ — which is better (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, 'be good, better')
glossary.ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘጽዑን: ጸዐነ — laden, loaded (ዘ- relative + passive participle ጽዑን of ጸዐነ 'load')
glossary.ዝኅሮ: ዝኅር — his store, treasure (?) (noun + -ሁ 'his'; cf. ዘኀረ 'store up') (?)
glossary.የብሰ: የብሰ — it dried, became dry (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ያጥፍእዎ: አጥፍአ — that they extinguish him/it (3mp subjunctive, causative of ጠፍአ + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ይደሉ: ደለወ — it is fitting, due (3m sg imperfect, d-l-w)
glossary.ይጸንሕ: ጸንሐ — he waits (3ms imperfect, G, ṣ-n-ḥ)
glossary.ይጼዐኑ: ጸዐነ — they carry, which carry (3mp imperfect, G, 'carry, bear, load'; active, not passive)
glossary.ዮጊኬ: ዮጊኬ — then, so now (?) (particle, interrogative/illative 'so then') (?)
glossary.ደንገፀት: ደንገፀ — she/it was startled, terrified (3fs perfect, G; ነፍስ is fem.)
glossary.ዳግመ: ዳግም — again, a second time (adverb, accusative form in -a)
glossary.ድንጉፁ: ድንጉፅ — terrified, startled (adjective, accusative as circumstantial)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብር — servant, slave (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · also the verb ገብረ: he did, made (3ms perfect, g-b-r; ገብረ ሠናየ 'he did good')
glossary.ገጽ: ገጽ — face (noun) · side, place (በ፩ ገጽ 'on one side, in one place')
glossary.ጐንዲያ: ጐንደየ — having lingered, delayed (?) (gerund, 3fs, of ጐንደየ 'linger, delay') (?)
glossary.ጐንዲዮ: ጐንደየ — having lingered, after a delay (?) (verbal noun/gerund of ጐንደየ) (?)
glossary.ጠቢብ: ጠቢብ — wise, a wise man (adjective used as noun)
glossary.ጸምአት: ጸምአ — she thirsted (3fs perfect, G, ṣ-m-ʾ)
glossary.ጻሕበ: ጻሕብ — bowl, dish (?) (noun, accusative; construct 'bowl of')
glossary.ፈቀድኩ: ፈቀደ — I wished, desired (1cs perfect, G)
glossary.፮: ፮ — 6, spoken ስድስቱ (sədstu) 'six'; chapter number (numeral) · count: ፮ ዓመተ 'six years', ፮ ሲሕ 'six thousand (?)'
